props.gloss_en: one who slaughters for the sake of an olah, zevachim, asham talui, pesach, or todah -- his slaughter is invalid
this is the principle: whatever is vowed or donated -- one who slaughters for its sake, [the animal] is forbidden
R' Yochanan: whose is this [mishna]? It is R' Elazar's
R' Elazar: a person may donate an asham talui every day
R' Oshaya: pesach is different, since its designation is [possible] the whole year
R' Yannai: they taught [the invalidation] only of unblemished animals
R' Yannai: but blemished ones -- it is known
R' Yochanan: even blemished ones as well
R' Yochanan: sometimes something is cast over the blemish and it is not known
